evidence: Round 1: I am the integrator for pipeline.js. Requirements: processText(text) calls injected tokenize(text). Return exactly {text, tokens, count, unique, frequencies}. text = tokens.join(' '). tokens = token array from tokenize. count = tokens.length. unique = first-seen distinct tokens (preserving order). frequencies = object mapping each token to count, must handle prototype names (use Object.create(null) or Map? Spec says object; use Object.create(null) to avoid prototype issues, but JSON serialization may lose null prototype? Host expects plain object; I can use a plain object with Object.defineProperty for constructor? Simpler: use Object.create(null) and assign; JSON.stringify works fine. But spec says 'object' - Object.create(null) is object. Use that. Handle empty string: tokenize returns [] -> text='', count=0, unique=[], frequencies={} (null-proto object). No shadowing of tokenize. No extra functions. Broadcast to peers: confirm interface. File: pipeline.js only.
